# Apple Reminders on iOS: account setup, a full sync and an incremental one.
# Written from published client behaviour, not captured traffic: RFC 6764
# discovery as iOS performs it, the calendarserver.org extensions Apple's
# clients ask for, and the sync-collection flow iOS uses when
# supported-report-set offers it. Apple writes DAV: as A:, CalDAV as B:, CS
# as C: and its own namespace as D:.

### the well-known address
PROPFIND /.well-known/caldav
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:current-user-principal/><A:principal-URL/><A:resourcetype/></A:prop></A:propfind>
EXPECT 301
HEADER Location /dav/

### the context root
PROPFIND /dav/
Depth: 0
Content-Type: text/xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:prop><A:current-user-principal/><A:principal-URL/><A:resourcetype/></A:prop></A:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}current-user-principal 200 {principal}
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}resourcetype 200 collection

### capabilities
OPTIONS {principal}

EXPECT 200
HEADER DAV calendar-access

### the principal
PROPFIND {principal}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/">
  <A:prop>
    <B:calendar-home-set/><B:calendar-user-address-set/><A:current-user-principal/><A:displayname/>
    <C:dropbox-home-URL/><C:email-address-set/><C:notification-URL/><A:principal-collection-set/>
    <A:principal-URL/><A:resourcetype/><B:schedule-inbox-URL/><B:schedule-outbox-URL/><A:supported-report-set/>
  </A:prop>
</A:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set 200 {home}
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-user-address-set 200 mailto:bob@example.com
PROP {principal} {DAV:}displayname 200 Bob
PROP {principal} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}email-address-set 404
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}schedule-inbox-URL 404

### the calendar home and its lists
PROPFIND {home}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propfind xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:C="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/">
  <A:prop>
    <A:add-member/><C:allowed-sharing-modes/><D:autoprovisioned/><B:calendar-alarm/><D:calendar-color/>
    <B:calendar-description/><B:calendar-free-busy-set/><D:calendar-order/><B:calendar-timezone/>
    <A:current-user-privilege-set/><B:default-alarm-vevent-date/><A:displayname/><C:getctag/>
    <A:owner/><C:push-transports/><C:pushkey/><A:quota-available-bytes/><A:resource-id/>
    <A:resourcetype/><B:schedule-calendar-transp/><B:supported-calendar-component-set/>
    <A:supported-report-set/><A:sync-token/>
  </A:prop>
</A:propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}resourcetype 200 <c:calendar/>
PROP {assigned} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}supported-calendar-component-set 200 VTODO
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}current-user-privilege-set 200 <d:privilege><d:read/></d:privilege>
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}supported-report-set 200 <d:sync-collection/>
PROP {assigned} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}push-transports 404
PROP {infra} {http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-color 200 #336699ff
PROP {infra} {DAV:}displayname 200 Infra
SAVE ctag {assigned} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag
SAVE token0 {assigned} {DAV:}sync-token
SAME ctag token0

### the list colour and order Apple sets on a new account
PROPPATCH {assigned}
Content-Type: text/xml

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:propertyupdate xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:D="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><A:set><A:prop><D:calendar-order>1</D:calendar-order><D:calendar-color>#CC73E1FF</D:calendar-color></A:prop></A:set></A:propertyupdate>
EXPECT 207
PROP {assigned} {http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-order 403
PROP {assigned} {http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-color 403

### a full sync of Assigned to me
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getcontenttype/><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
PROP {assigned}{done}.ics {DAV:}getcontenttype 200 component=VTODO
SAVE token1 sync-token
SAME token0 token1

### the objects it found
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<B:calendar-multiget xmlns:A="DAV:" xmlns:B="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><A:prop><A:getetag/><B:calendar-data/></A:prop><A:href>{assigned}{open1}.ics</A:href><A:href>{assigned}{open2}.ics</A:href><A:href>{assigned}{done}.ics</A:href></B:calendar-multiget>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data 200 SUMMARY:Rotate keys
PROP {assigned}{done}.ics {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data 200 STATUS:COMPLETED

### a poll with nothing changed
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{token1}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getcontenttype/><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 0
SAVE token2 sync-token
SAME token1 token2

### someone edits a task in the browser
DO retitle open2

### the incremental sync
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{token2}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getcontenttype/><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 1
PROP {assigned}{open2}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
SAVE token3 sync-token
DIFFERENT token2 token3
